title: Aussies should be helping each other.
intro: This is an open-source community project that helps Australians living in or visiting the Bay Area find one another.

sections.heading: Don't leak your actual location
sections.body: Every pin represents the centre of a neighbourhood. We don’t collect your exact address or GPS location. Publishing a profile shares your name, profile photo, job description, suburb, LinkedIn link, contact email and visitor dates with people who can access this directory.

sections.heading: Coming and going
sections.body: Resident profiles stay visible. Visitors appear from their arrival date through their departure date, inclusive, using San Francisco time. Your profile view always shows your saved entry and whether it is visible on the map.

sections.heading: Looking after the community
sections.body: Members self-identify as Australian; this is not a nationality verification service. Three different directory profiles reporting a profile will hide it for seven days. Duplicate reports and self-reports don’t count. Editing a profile doesn’t remove a suspension. Automatic reporting can be abused; a human moderation and appeal workflow is still needed before a broad launch.

sections.heading: Your profile, your choice
sections.body: No account is required. This browser remembers your profile; keep your private edit link to update or remove it on another device. Anyone with that link can manage your entry, so keep it private. Minimal report records are retained to prevent repeat reporting.

sections.heading: Build with us
sections.body: Code is MIT licensed. Contributions, issues and thoughtful suggestions are welcome.

sections.heading: What’s in this first version
sections.body: Shared profiles and reporting use a hosted database. Profiles are managed through a private edit link, without ChatGPT sign-in. LinkedIn links are supported; automatic LinkedIn name/photo importing is not connected. Only real member profiles appear on the map. Members upload their own profile photos; existing profiles show initials until a photo is added.
